events.headline: A.J. Brown off the injury report for Thursday at Chicago; TreVeyon Henderson cleared for Week 7
events.detail: Brown practiced in full Wednesday after returning from IR in Week 6, when he ran 97% of the routes with a 34% target share but caught three of ten targets for 27 yards with three drops. Henderson (right ankle) is practicing in full and cleared for Week 7. Romeo Doubs went on IR with a shoulder injury from Week 6 and misses at least four games; Mack Hollins (calf) is also on IR. New England plays Thursday night.
events.so_what: Brown is a start: the target share is the signal and the drops are noise, and Doubs' absence concentrates even more of the passing game on him. Henderson's return puts Rhamondre Stevenson back into a split, so neither back is a safe RB2 until the Thursday workload shows who leads.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Lamar Jackson (ankle) limited Wednesday; Minter calls it "a day-by-day thing"
events.detail: Jackson got limited work Wednesday, his first practice since spraining his left ankle Oct. 4 against Tennessee. He has missed two games: Tyler Huntley led a comeback win in Atlanta in Week 5, then Baltimore lost 13-10 to Cleveland in Week 6, when Huntley scored 13.4 fantasy points and Derrick Henry lost a fumble that set up the tying TD. The Ravens (4-2) host Cincinnati. Huntley starts if Jackson sits.
events.so_what: Practicing at all is progress, but limited on Wednesday is still a forecast, so keep a QB2 through Friday's designation. If Jackson plays, his rushing is the premium this format pays for and he is an automatic start. Huntley only matters as a stream if Jackson is ruled out.

source.label: Fox Sports: NFL Catchup, Giants to start J.J. McCarthy (Oct. 21)

events.headline: John Harbaugh names J.J. McCarthy the Giants starter over Jameis Winston for Week 7 at Houston
events.detail: McCarthy replaced Winston early in the fourth quarter of the 34-27 loss to New Orleans and threw for 243 yards, a TD and an INT with 26 rushing yards. Winston had thrown two second-half interceptions and had started four of the last five games since Jaxson Dart's season-ending knee injury. The Giants acquired McCarthy from Minnesota in September for a 2027 fifth-round pick. New York is 3-2-1 and leads the NFC East.
events.so_what: McCarthy's legs add a little rushing floor, but a QB on his first start in a new offense is a deep-league stream at most. The bigger question is Malik Nabers, the Giants' clear top target: a QB change does not move his target share much, so he stays in lineups.

source.label: Fox Sports: NFL Catchup, Giants to start J.J. McCarthy (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Josh Jacobs back at Packers practice after removal from the commissioner's exempt list; eligible Oct. 25 at Detroit
events.detail: The NFL announced Oct. 16 it would remove Jacobs from the exempt list effective Oct. 19. He has missed Green Bay's first six games after being placed on the list Aug. 30 following misdemeanor battery and criminal damage charges, to which he pleaded no contest. He practiced Wednesday and apologized at his first media availability; Matt LaFleur said "I believe in second chances." The league's personal-conduct investigation continues and a suspension is still possible.
events.so_what: Jacobs is expected to play Sunday and walks back into a lead-back role with goal-line work, so he returns to RB2 consideration immediately. The open conduct investigation is real risk to the rest-of-season value, not to this week's start.

source.label: Fox Sports: NFL Catchup, Josh Jacobs back at Packers practice (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Rashee Rice (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday; still rehabbing ahead of Week 7 at Seattle
events.detail: Rice missed Week 6, a 22-6 win over the Chargers in which Patrick Mahomes threw for 272 yards and Xavier Worthy led the team with 73 receiving yards. Andy Reid said Wednesday Rice is making progress but did not practice. Travis Kelce (ankle) played through it in Week 6 and was limited Wednesday. Tyquan Thornton needs ankle surgery and is expected to miss 12-16 weeks.
events.so_what: A Wednesday DNP after already missing a game points to a third straight absence; do not start Rice without a practice this week. Worthy is the receiver to start while Rice sits.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Breece Hall (quad) did not practice Wednesday; Aaron Glenn declines to rule him out
events.detail: Hall has been out since Week 3. Glenn would not rule him out for Sunday against Miami and said Hall remains the starter when healthy, but Braelon Allen will keep getting touches. Allen has 220 scrimmage yards and a TD over the last two weeks. WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) returned to limited practice.
events.so_what: Until Hall practices, start Allen as a volume RB2 and keep Hall on the bench. When Hall does return, his coach has already said Allen keeps a share, so do not expect Hall's early-season workload back right away.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Baker Mayfield (thumb) full practice for the first time since Week 3; Emeka Egbuka in concussion protocol
events.detail: Mayfield, out since dislocating his throwing-hand thumb in Week 3, was a full participant Wednesday wearing a glove; Todd Bowles called him "effective" and "encouraging" and expects to decide Friday between Mayfield and Jalon Daniels. Daniels threw for 164 yards and a TD with interceptions and six sacks in the Week 6 overtime loss to Pittsburgh. Egbuka is in concussion protocol. Bucky Irving (illness) did not practice.
events.so_what: Mayfield back would lift every Tampa pass-catcher; Daniels has not supported a fantasy starter. Egbuka cannot be started until he clears protocol, and that clearance is the item to watch, not the practice line. Hold the Tampa receivers through Friday.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Zach Charbonnet (ACL) a full practice participant but still on IR; activation before Seattle hosts Kansas City not yet announced
events.detail: Charbonnet was a full participant Wednesday for the first time since his practice window opened Oct. 1. Emanuel Wilson led Seattle with 14 carries in Week 6, but his snap share fell to 32%. Jadarian Price is on IR (chest).
events.so_what: Activation is not confirmed, so he is a stash, not a start, this week. Seattle runs near the goal line as often as anyone, and Charbonnet is the back most likely to take that work once he is back, which caps Wilson's value right away.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) limited; Todd Monken optimistic he and Dylan Sampson (knee) both play vs. Tennessee
events.detail: Judkins missed Week 6 after leaving in a walking boot and was limited Wednesday. Sampson was activated from IR in Week 6 and has a chance to play. Monken said he is optimistic both are available Sunday. Raheim Sanders (hip) is on IR.
events.so_what: Optimism is not a clearance. If Judkins plays he is the lead back and a start; if he sits, Sampson gets the larger share. Wait for Friday's designations before choosing.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) missed Wednesday practice; Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight split Week 6
events.detail: Love missed Week 6 and did not practice Wednesday, per head coach Mike LaFleur. In the 18-16 win over the Rams, Allgeier played 56% of the snaps with 18 carries for 38 yards; Knight played 44% and ran 15 times for 80 yards with two catches for 18. Allgeier is expected to keep goal-line work. Arizona hosts Denver.
events.so_what: Treat Love as doubtful until he practices. Without him, this is a near-even split with Knight the more efficient back and Allgeier holding the short touchdowns, so neither is better than a FLEX, and Knight is the waiver add of the two.

source.label: Sports Illustrated: Jeremiyah Love missing Week 7 would make Allgeier and Knight relevant

events.headline: Mike Evans (Achilles) re-aggravated in Week 6 and expected to miss time; Christian Kirk practicing in full
events.detail: Evans left the 23-17 Monday night win over Washington before halftime after re-aggravating the Achilles; he had also been playing through two broken ribs. Kyle Shanahan called it Achilles tendinitis needing no more testing and did not rule out Sunday at Atlanta, but NBC Sports Bay Area reported the tendon is intact and the 49ers are bracing for him to miss at least that game. San Francisco has a Week 8 bye. Deebo Samuel (hamstring) is out multiple weeks, Ricky Pearsall is on season-ending IR, and Kirk (calf) is practicing in full.
events.so_what: Plan on Evans sitting Week 7; with the bye behind it, this could cost two lineup weeks, not one. Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle absorb the volume, and Kirk is the short-term No. 1 receiver, a FLEX if you are short at WR.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) practicing in full; Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited
events.detail: Hockenson was hurt in the opening minute of the Week 5 game at New Orleans and Addison was inactive that day. Both are full participants this week, as is RB Jordan Mason (thumb), whose 21-day IR window is open. Jefferson was limited with an ankle. Minnesota hosts Indianapolis.
events.so_what: Full practice is a strong sign but not a clearance; Hockenson still needs to be off the final report. Jefferson's limited tag is the one to track Friday. If all three play, Addison is a FLEX, not a start.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Tank Dell expected to make his season debut vs. the Giants; David Montgomery (groin) still sidelined
events.detail: Dell, back from his 2024 knee injury, is expected to play Sunday; Houston waived LB Jamal Hill to make room. Montgomery is week-to-week and did not start the week practicing, so Woody Marks leads the backfield. Jawhar Jordan went on IR. TE Dalton Schultz (quad) did not practice Wednesday. Houston beat Jacksonville 34-31 in London in Week 6 as C.J. Stroud threw for 306 yards and three TDs.
events.so_what: Dell is a bench stash for one week to see his snap count; a first game in two years rarely comes with a full route share. Marks stays a volume RB2 while Montgomery is out. Stroud's passing game now has more mouths than targets, which matters most for Nico Collins' ceiling.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing early in Week 7 after missing the Titans loss
events.detail: Warren sat out the 26-20 loss at Tennessee, where Daniel Jones threw two more interceptions and spread catches across eight receivers. Keenan Allen caught eight passes and scored 16.2 fantasy points; Josh Downs had four for 40. Alec Pierce (heel) remains on IR and is trying to avoid surgery. Indianapolis visits Minnesota.
events.so_what: Warren is trending toward a second straight absence; have a TE plan ready by Friday, since this format starts only one and the position is thin. Allen is the receiver who gained most from Warren's absence.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Ladd McConkey now in concussion protocol, likely back after the Chargers' Week 8 bye; Tre' Harris (hamstring) could return then too
events.detail: McConkey missed Week 6 with a foot injury and is now listed with a concussion. Tre' Harris (hamstring) could return after the bye. The Chargers lost 22-6 at Kansas City in Week 6; Justin Herbert leads the league with eight interceptions, and Omarion Hampton played 49% of the snaps in a three-back rotation with Kimani Vidal.
events.so_what: McConkey is a hold through the bye, not a Week 7 start. Hampton's 49% snap share in a rotation makes him a FLEX at best until the backfield sorts out.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Davante Adams (ruptured hamstring) to IR, out 6-10 weeks; Puka Nacua's target share set to climb
events.detail: Sean McVay said Adams ruptured his semitendinosus on a noncontact route late in the 18-16 loss to Arizona and will miss six to 10 weeks. Ian Rapoport reported surgery to clean out the tendon, with hopes of a return around the Rams' Week 11 bye. He was placed on IR Tuesday. Adams had 30 catches for 480 yards and four TDs on 49 targets in six games. Kicker Blake Grupe (knee) also left the game.
events.so_what: Adams is a long IR stash; at the short end he is back for Week 13, at the long end after the fantasy regular season. Nacua becomes the clear focal point of the Rams' passing game and a must-start every week. Tyler Higbee becomes a startable TE while Terrance Ferguson is out.

source.label: AJC: Rams WR Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks with hamstring injury

events.headline: Terry McLaurin out for the season with a torn patellar tendon, per Dan Quinn
events.detail: McLaurin tore the patellar tendon in his left knee cutting on a route in the first quarter of the Week 6 Monday night loss to San Francisco and will have surgery. He led Washington with 15 catches for 230 yards. Quinn said "we'll lean on a number of guys"; Treylon Burks left Week 6 hurt and Jaylin Lane (ankle) is likely out for the season. Stefon Diggs is expected to be the de facto No. 1 receiver.
events.so_what: McLaurin can be dropped outright unless your league has a free IR slot you will not need. Diggs gains the most volume and is worth starting as a WR3 or FLEX; Burks is a speculative add only once his own injury clears.

source.label: ESPN: WR McLaurin has season-ending knee injury, Commanders' Quinn says

events.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) has missed two games; Eagles see a "realistic" chance he returns Monday night vs. Dallas
events.detail: Barkley hurt the hamstring in the first quarter of the Oct. 4 loss to the Rams and missed Weeks 5 and 6. Per ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, Philadelphia believes there is a realistic chance he plays Oct. 26 against Dallas. Dameon Pierce played 95% of the snaps in Week 6 with Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley both on IR; the Eagles signed Elijah Mitchell to the practice squad and waived Jaydon Blue.
events.so_what: The Monday game gives Barkley an extra day, which helps him play but hurts you: you must set the rest of your lineup before you know. If he is not listed Out on Friday, start him only if you have a Monday-night fallback; otherwise Pierce is a volume start while Barkley sits.

source.label: Bleacher Report: Saquon Barkley injury update, earliest timeline for return

events.headline: Jalen Hurts expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in both lungs; Tanner McKee is the starter
events.detail: The Eagles and agent Nicole Lynn confirmed deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli after Hurts was placed on IR Saturday with a calf clot traced to a cleat to the calf Oct. 4. He cannot do football activity while on blood thinners; Rapoport reported treatment takes at least three months, and the AP reported he is expected to miss the season. McKee went 26 of 45 for 215 yards and a TD in a 25-14 loss to Carolina and stays the starter; DeVonta Smith set a career high with 14 targets. Philadelphia is 2-4.
events.so_what: Hurts' rushing touchdowns were the most valuable QB skill in this format, and they are gone for the season; drop him unless you have an IR slot to spare. McKee has no rushing floor and is not a stream. Smith's 14 targets say the passing volume survives, so keep starting him.

source.label: AP via WOWT: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts expected to miss rest of season with blood clots

events.headline: Cam Skattebo gets zero carries in Week 6 after an overtime fumble; Harbaugh says the Giants RB job is open
events.detail: Skattebo played six snaps with no carries or targets in the 34-27 loss to New Orleans, the week after his overtime fumble in field-goal range against Washington, his fourth fumble in six games. He said "I got punished"; Harbaugh said it was "not by design" and that "one of those guys needs to step up and be the back." Najee Harris started, Tyrone Tracy scored twice, and the backfield ran for 34 yards on 14 carries.
events.so_what: This is now a four-back committee with no leader, so no Giants back is a safe start; the INT-light, fumble-heavy scoring here makes ball security exactly what the coach is screening for. Skattebo is a bench hold at most until he earns carries back.

source.label: Bleacher Report: Cam Skattebo's role discussed by John Harbaugh after 0 carries

events.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) active and starts Week 6, leading Chicago past Atlanta 31-23
events.detail: Williams returned after missing three games with what he later called a "pretty serious" hamstring tear and led two early touchdown drives. Colston Loveland scored 18.5 fantasy points on seven targets. Atlanta's Michael Penix Jr. also played through his rib injury. The Bears host New England on Thursday; RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) is out for a third straight game.
events.so_what: Williams is back as the Bears' starter, which settles the Bagent/Keenum question and makes Loveland a TE1 again. With Monangai out, Chicago's backfield is a committee to avoid Thursday.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 6 big takeaways and fantasy spin

events.headline: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) active and starts Week 6 at Chicago
events.detail: Penix started despite the rib injury that left the Falcons waiting on a Wednesday update a week earlier. He was pressured on 46% of his dropbacks in the 31-23 loss, and returner Zachariah Branch lost two fumbles.
events.so_what: He is playing, so this is no longer an injury question; the pressure rate is the problem, and it limits him to a QB2. Drake London's value does not depend on Penix's health anymore.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 6 big takeaways and fantasy spin

events.headline: CeeDee Lamb (quad bruise) active and plays Week 6 at Green Bay
events.detail: Lamb played in the 23-13 loss to the Packers after the quad bruise Stephen Jones had called not serious. Dak Prescott threw two first-half interceptions, one after Lamb slipped on the route. Green Bay's Matthew Golden caught 6 of 13 targets for 104 yards and a TD.
events.so_what: The injury is behind him; keep Lamb in lineups. Prescott's interceptions cost only one point each here, so a turnover-heavy day does less damage to the Dallas passing game than it would elsewhere.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 6 big takeaways and fantasy spin

events.headline: Germie Bernard catches 11 of 12 targets for 87 yards and the OT winner as the Steelers' WR room thins
events.detail: With Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot) and Roman Wilson on IR (finger), Bernard scored 25.7 fantasy points in the 26-19 overtime win at Tampa Bay. DK Metcalf remains the No. 1. Rico Dowdle (toe) was limited to start Week 7, likely a maintenance day. Pittsburgh plays New Orleans in Paris in Week 7.
events.so_what: Twelve targets is a real role, not a one-week spike, while Pittman and Wilson are both out; Bernard is a FLEX start and worth a waiver claim where he is still available. His value falls back once Pittman returns.

source.label: ESPN: NFL Week 6 big takeaways and fantasy spin

events.headline: Texans complete trade for Marvin Harrison Jr.; Cardinals get 2027 second- and sixth-round picks
events.detail: Houston sent 2027 second- and sixth-round picks to Arizona for Harrison and a 2027 seventh, per ESPN and NFL Network. He was inactive Sunday while the deal was finalized and reunites with C.J. Stroud, his Ohio State quarterback in 2021-22. Harrison had 5 catches on 12 targets for 85 yards and a TD through four games. In Arizona, Trey McBride, Michael Wilson, Kendrick Bourne and Jeremiyah Love all had more targets than him. Houston (now 1-4) also lost David Montgomery to a groin injury Sunday.
events.so_what: Houston needed a second receiver behind Nico Collins, so Harrison lands in a role with real targets to win rather than a crowded room; treat him as a FLEX with WR2 upside once he has a practice week with Stroud, not a Week 6 auto-start. In Arizona his departure consolidates looks for McBride and Wilson. Do not sell Harrison at his Arizona price.

source.label: ESPN: Texans complete trade with Cardinals for WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
